scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to finite connected complete multipartite graphs and k at least 2. Its universal proof is structural; exhaustive enumeration through order 8 is only a stress test. The initiating k-color paper and the earlier two-color paper were inspected at the relevant definitions and complete-graph/bipartite statements; an unindexed equivalent formulation remains a residual literature risk.
title: Closed-neighborhood balance collapses complete multipartite graphs to cliques
